epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false project stagnation warning rate from 100% of checks to 0%
requirements: R1: Patch existing deliverable readiness tracking logic to accurately update as tasks are resolved, unblocking the 5/19 stagnation

slices.title: Fix deliverable readiness tracking calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the metric fix for this epic, I want the backend calculation to accurately count resolved tasks, so that false stagnation warnings are eliminated
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given task resolution occurs, When the deliverable readiness tracking evaluates the state, Then the readiness ratio correctly increments beyond 5/19.
Given the project observer evaluates project state, When the readiness ratio is fetched, Then no false stagnation warning is emitted if progress has been made.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce metric calculation error rate from 100% to 0% for updated task tracking
